verses.text: Yahweh, who shall dwell in your sanctuary? Who shall live on your holy hill?
lines: Yahweh, who shall dwell in your sanctuary?
Who shall live on your holy hill?

verses.text: He who walks blamelessly and does what is right, and speaks truth in his heart;
lines: He who walks blamelessly and does what is right,
and speaks truth in his heart;

verses.text: he who doesn’t slander with his tongue, nor does evil to his friend, nor casts slurs against his fellow man;
lines: he who doesn’t slander with his tongue,
nor does evil to his friend,
nor casts slurs against his fellow man;

verses.text: in whose eyes a vile man is despised, but who honors those who fear Yahweh; he who keeps an oath even when it hurts, and doesn’t change;
lines: in whose eyes a vile man is despised,
but who honors those who fear Yahweh;
he who keeps an oath even when it hurts, and doesn’t change;

verses.text: he who doesn’t lend out his money for usury, nor take a bribe against the innocent. He who does these things shall never be shaken.
lines: he who doesn’t lend out his money for usury,
nor take a bribe against the innocent.
He who does these things shall never be shaken.
